name: @scenity/traffic-runtime
author: Leonardo Amoroso Custodio
description: The runtime face of the traffic plugin: a small simulation of a road with a pedestrian crossing and a push-button signal (defineSimulation), and the components traffic.signal, traffic.vehicle, traffic.pedestrian and traffic.button. It also holds a system that puts the cars, the walkers and the lamps of the signals in the scene, and the input map of the button in the play mode.
